situation: It's 11 pm. Your sixteen-year-old took the car, and it is now wedged against the hardware store wall.

scenario.title: He Took the Car
scenario.setting: A narrow street at night outside a shuttered hardware store, a car with a crumpled bumper against a wall, a streetlight.
scenario.user_goal: Find out what really happened, and deal with it.
user_knows: He is sixteen and has no licence

cast.name: Ethan
cast.appearance: Teenage boy about 16, black hoodie, staring at the ground, car key in his fist
cast.voice: Mumbling, one word answers, flares up
cast.history: You argued about his phone this morning.
cast.goal: Keep his friend out of it
cast.secret: He wasn't driving: his friend was, and he is taking the blame
cast.reveal_when: You stop shouting and ask who he is protecting
red_lines: Won't name his friend to a stranger

cast.name: Mr. Park
cast.appearance: Man about 62, cardigan over pyjamas, slippers, torch in his hand
cast.voice: Gruff, tired, softer than he sounds
cast.history: You have bought from him for ten years.
cast.secret: His security camera caught who was at the wheel
cast.reveal_when: You apologise first and ask if he saw anything
red_lines: Won't call the police if treated with respect

cast.name: Your husband
cast.appearance: Man about 46, work shirt, coat thrown on, out of breath
cast.voice: Loud at first, then guilty and quiet
cast.secret: He did the same thing at seventeen and never told you
cast.reveal_when: You ask him why he's so angry

scenario.opening_line: It's—I know. I know, okay? Don't.

events.description: A shutter rattles up. The owner comes out in his slippers with a torch.
events.shot: An older man in slippers shines a torch on the dented car beside the teenage boy.

events.description: A taxi door slams. Your husband comes up the street fast.
events.shot: A man in a work shirt strides up the street toward the boy and the older man.

events.description: The boy's phone lights up in his hand. He turns it over before anyone can see.
events.shot: The teenage boy turns his glowing phone face down while the two men watch him.

success_criteria: Finds out who was really driving
Keeps the boy talking to you

Your husband.name: An old photo of a car
